objective: Synthetic fixture: a completed Full SDD project used only by validator tests.

requirements.statement: The service exposes an operation that returns the synthetic item list.
The interface renders the synthetic item list.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The operation returns every synthetic item.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Automated test comparing the response with the expected list.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The interface shows each synthetic item.
acceptance_criteria.verification: End-to-end test asserting the rendered rows.

decisions.statement: Keep the list logic in a single service module.
decisions.rationale: One owner for the behavior keeps both requirements consistent.

tasks.title: Render the list in the interface

risks.description: List growth could slow the operation.
risks.mitigation: Add pagination if the list exceeds the agreed size; revert the change if latency regresses.

approvals.reference: approval record 1 in the project tracker

evidence.description: Read the diff and the test output for the list operation; both criteria hold.
Reviewed the rendered rows in the end-to-end run and confirmed each item is shown.
